much power

1. Counter-pressure too
low
2. The liquid is heavier
than water
3. Foreign body in pump
4. Electric motor is
running on 2 phases
5. RPM too high
6. Pump and electric
motor not aligned.

Insert orifice plate or check
valve/Contact DESMI
Contact DESMI
Dismantle the pump, remove
the cause
Check fuses, cable
connection, and cable
Fit bigger V-belt pulley on
pump. Change RPM of
electric motor.
Align unit (see para. about
alignment)
